 RF Engineer 
Embedded Engineering is looking for an RF engineer to expand our team in Rijswijk (on the northern edge of Delft). 
About the job 
We are looking for an enthusiastic and capable RF engineer who can take responsibility for the design, development and validation of RF systems and subsystems. You will be involved in product development and R&D projects, working on advanced military communication and sensing solutions. 
The team you will be working in consists of 5-10 embedded software, FPGA and hardware engineers. You will collaborate across multiple disciplines, including digital design, embedded software and system engineering. 
Embedded Engineering is a small and dynamic high-tech company that focuses on product development for Defence and Security applications. Affinity with this application domain is essential. We value open communication, ownership, willingness to learn and grow, and-last but not least-technical expertise and skills. 
Our remuneration package includes (among other benefits) 31 days of paid vacation per year, profit sharing, a pension plan, a company phone or phone allowance and company lunches. Your starting salary will depend on your experience and qualifications; the indicative salary range is € 4500 to € 8000 gross/month, not including vacation pay, bonuses and profit sharing. You will receive an annual pay rise depending on performance relative to your targets, that are agreed upon annually. 
The working language at Embedded Engineering is English. 
Responsibilities 
Your responsibilities will include: - Designing and developing RF systems and subsystems for military communication and sensing applications. - Developing RF waveforms and signal chains, including modulation, filtering and amplification. - Contributing to analog RF electronics (e.g. LNAs, mixers, oscillators, power amplifiers). - Performing RF simulations - Developing ...
